$comment: The fixed query set for AI Overview citation tracking. Fixed on purpose: the
series is only comparable against itself, so changing this file starts a new
baseline rather than continuing the old one.
Selection rule (from the phase-3 design): the highest-impression queries in the
Search Console 3-month report that already return an AI Overview, spanning several
cities and two languages, plus vitamin D queries with measurable Trends volume.
The gscImpressions figures are from the 2026-05-08 to 2026-08-07 report.

queries.q: what time is sunset in tokyo in may
what time is sunset in toronto in august
a que hora anochece en londres en marzo
a que hora anochece en nueva york en septiembre
a qué hora amanece en tenerife
